entities.name: Pre-Generation Enhancement
entities.description: A category of generation enhancement techniques focusing on improving input data or representations before feeding them into the generator.

entities.name: Wu et al. [182]
entities.description: A method that employs LLMs to rewrite retrieved graph data to enhance naturalness and semantic richness.

entities.name: DALK
entities.description: A method that utilizes retrieved graph data to rewrite the query.

entities.name: Cheng et al. [20]
entities.description: A method that leverages LLMs to generate a reasoning plan and answer queries according to the plan.

entities.name: Taunk et al. [158]
entities.description: A method aiming to enhance GNNs by enabling them to learn graph representations relevant to queries.

entities.description: A method aiming to enhance GNNs by enabling them to learn graph representations relevant to queries.
